A_best: The unattended-resilience improvement (per-stage Router fallbacks with bounded retries) is exactly the right Router lever for a pipeline nobody is watching, and the aider/LiteLLM analysis is genuinely deep — live-probed to 200 on /v1/messages via api_base, traced to litellm's openai common_utils vs the Anthropic handler's _get_httpx_client, with i7 proposing to validate any reviewer swap against the repo's own review_iclr_bench ground truth.
